stage1.impression: A restrained, high-key editorial idea: a black box on white snow among white birches reads at once, and the palette is disciplined. It still reads as CG. The speaker sits frontal and flat with no contact shadow, as if pasted in. The snow is a smeared, streaky, paper-white field with no sparkle or sun-and-shadow modelling. The bark looks painted, there is no visible woodsmoke, and nearly 40% of the frame is empty, blurred foreground.
